name: Account 11 Choice
definition: Choice between a cash account, a charges account or a tax account.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account in which cash is maintained.

ChargesAccount.name: Charges Account
ChargesAccount.definition: Account to be used for charges if different from the account for payment.

TaxAccount.name: Tax Account
TaxAccount.definition: Account to be used for taxes if different from the account for payment.
